purpose: Meshy-ready, single-accessory worn-character reference sets. Each accessory is supplied as four separate orthographic images.
sharedConstraints: Use the same NAVA kitten identity, scale, proportions, colors, and neutral seated pose in every view.
Each set contains exactly one accessory and no background prop.
Lighting is soft, even, and shadowless on a pale cool-gray background.
Files are separate images rather than a collage so they can be uploaded directly to multi-image 3D reconstruction tools.

records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: one image in a four-view 3D reconstruction set. Create a single full-body orthographic render of the exact NAVA kitten from input1, wearing ONLY one cherry-red satin head bow from input2. Preserve the exact kitten identity and proportions: pale ice-blue fluffy layered cheek ruff, two triangular ears, circular dark navy face mask, closed white smiling eyes and tiny white triangular nose when visible, two short navy-tipped front paws, one thick pale-blue tail. The bow is attached naturally at the kitten's LEFT ear base (viewer RIGHT in the front view): medium-large but not oversized, centered just outside the ear base, a soft gathered satin knot with two plump asymmetric loops and short folded ribbon ends, following the skull/ear angle with convincing contact and slight fur compression. It must never float, penetrate the ear, duplicate, swap sides, become a neck bow, or appear on the opposite ear. Soft cherry red with restrained satin sheen; rounded thickness, visible folds, no hard plastic look. Same pale cool-gray background and soft even shadowless lighting across all views. Whole kitten centered with 9 percent margin, no cast shadow, no ground line, no text, no collage, no border. Strict straight FRONT view. Both ears visible. Bow on viewer RIGHT at left-ear base. Tail lies on viewer RIGHT.
